channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: China expels 2 top generals ‘disloyal’ to CCP: Why is Xi Jinping purging PLA's top ranks?
item.description: China expelled two senior generals, Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli, over allegations of corruption and disloyalty. Their removal, approved by President Xi Jinping, reflects anti-corruption efforts within the PLA, reshaping military leadership and emphasizing political loyalty to the Communist Party.

item.title: ‘Soul-sucking’: Techie's viral post on AI coding tools sparks debate, Elon Musk reacts
item.description: The techie also claimed employees face intense pressure to ship products at maximum speed, leaving them with little to no time to review the AI's output or understand the underlying code.

item.title: UNGA 2026: Wars, AI fears and UN reform dominate as world leaders gather in NYC – What else in on agenda?
item.description: The annual meeting of world leaders at the beginning of the General Assembly session this week. It is usually the first debate of the session and the only one in which Heads of State and Governments regularly participate.

item.title: IIT Bombay suicide: Student Reps demand systemic reforms, clarify stance on Prof Doolla | Top updates
item.description: The student body has emphasised that their demonstrations were a push for systemic institutional reforms and urged that it must not be misconstrued as an endorsement of academic misconduct.

item.title: White House launches ‘Trump TV’ as CNN, MS NOW and Politico move court over press ban: What we know so far
item.description: Announcing the launch, the official X account of The White House said, “IT'S LIVE. TRUMP TV IS STREAMING NOW. 24/7, updated in real time…”

item.title: Family linked to alleged Chinese spy donated $4.4m to Newsom, other California politicians; who is Fang Fang?
item.description: A California family that donated over $4.4 million to politicians including Gavin Newsom and Kamala Harris faces scrutiny over alleged links to suspected Chinese spy Christine Fang and reported ties to Chinese government officials.

item.title: Viral Vande Bharat video shows ugly reality of passenger etiquette — ‘Maybe we don't deserve it’
item.description: Despite the housekeeping staff regularly walking through the coach to collect waste, the video showed garbage haphazardly left behind by the travellers.

item.title: Taylor Swift gets new MTV VMA honour as Madonna returns: 5 things to know about 2026 awards
item.description: Taylor Swift will receive the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards. The ceremony will also feature Madonna’s return to the VMA stage, Snoop Dogg as host and Nirvana receiving the Video Vanguard Award.

item.title: Over 1,000 flights cancelled as air travel disrupted across US Northeast; services resume: What caused the outage?
item.description: More than 1,000 flights were cancelled nationwide, and over 6,000 were delayed on Monday, with Newark and Philadelphia hit the hardest, a report claims.

item.title: US-Iran War LIVE: US threatens Iran airlines with shutdown; oil prices edge higher
item.description: US-Iran War LIVE: Oil prices edge higher as markets await possible talks between Trump and Iran's Pezeshkian at the UN. Houthis intensify attacks on Saudi Arabia as Aramco boosts crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh to Gujarat: how job crisis differs in India’s poll-bound states
item.description: Ahead of crucial state polls, Time Use survey reveals vast employment disparities—from UP’s low employment participation rate to Gujarat’s formal enterprise employment.&nbsp;

item.title: Gracie Mansion meeting: Zohran Mamdani hosts Donald Trump in New York as UN General Assembly week begins
item.description: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani hosted President Donald Trump at Gracie Mansion on Monday for their third face-to-face meeting, with housing, federal funding and issues affecting New Yorkers expected to feature in talks.

item.title: Man Shot by ICE in Austin Says He Still Has Bullet in His Body
item.description: A Venezuelan man who was shot by a US immigration officer in Austin on Sunday says he still has a bullet lodged in his body.

item.title: El Niño ties record intensity: What 3.07°C Pacific warming means for weather from Central America to Indonesia
item.description: El Niño has matched the strongest level recorded on a widely used measure, with Pacific sea surface temperatures 3.07°C above average. Its effects are already being felt through drought, wildfires and water shortages across several regions.

item.title: UN Scrambles to Avoid a Repeat of Trump’s 2025 Escalator Snafu
item.description: The defining moment of 2025’s gathering of world leaders at the United Nations may have been Donald Trump’s accusation of “sabotage” after his teleprompter blinked out and an escalator stalled while he was on it.

item.title: NYC Airports Face Delays After Air Traffic Control Outage
item.description: Flights at New York’s major airports were disrupted after a technical problem at an air traffic control facility in Philadelphia, snarling travel and delaying the arrival of visitors for the United Nations General Assembly.

item.title: Jennifer Eckhart dies at 36: Former Fox Business producer found dead at Florida home- What we know
item.description: Former Fox News producer Jennifer Eckhart has died at 36 after being found at her Florida home. She later became a podcast host and was known for her 2020 lawsuit against former Fox News anchor Ed Henry.

item.title: El Niño could become strongest on record, California Governor Gavin Newsom declares statewide emergency
item.description: California faces historic El Nino storms, prompting Governor Newsom to declare a statewide emergency. Measures aim to protect communities and infrastructure as authorities prepare for severe weather, with local emergencies already declared in several counties affected by recent flooding.

item.title: 53-year-old single father loses 30 kg in 18 months: The reason behind his fitness journey will move you
item.description: A father from Mumbai went from 115 kg weigh to 85 kg weight in order to ‘outlive’ his son. The 53-year-old Indian man shared that he decided to get healthy to become the primary care giver of his son with special needs. Check his emotional story.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe-led Maharashtra FDA raids Swiggy Instamart, Amazon warehouse in Mumbai: Rat, cockroaches found
item.description: The FDA said it ordered the immediate suspension of the food licence of M/s Swinsta ENT Private Limited, which operates a Swiggy Instamart dark store in Ballard Estate in south Mumbai.

item.title: Bengaluru rent leaves woman shocked, ₹60,000 for 2BHK with ₹3-8 lakh deposit: ‘You might find God, but house not sure…’
item.description: A woman shared that she struggled to find a house in Bengaluru despite living there for past few years as landlords charge high rental fee with additional maintenance and deposit. She alleged that nobody questions why rent prices are so high in Bengaluru.

item.title: Looksmaxxing, cuffing season, vibe coding and more: US dictionary Merriam-Webster gets a ‘glow up’ with 1,400 new words
item.description: Merriam-Webster added 1,400 new words to its dictionary including words like Looksmaxxing, cuffing season, vibe coding and more. It also gave a nod to AI with the new word uncanny valley.

item.title: 'I was completely fine with it': Patrick Clancy on suicidal thoughts, his children and starting a new family
item.description: Patrick Clancy spoke about his children, Lindsay Clancy’s mental illness, forgiveness, suicidal thoughts and online conspiracy theories in his first televised interview since the murder trial ended in a mistrial.

item.title: Trump blocks CNN, MS NOW and Politico: Why White House press pool matters
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sued President Donald Trump and other members of his administration on Monday for banning them from White House grounds, saying it violated their rights to free speech and a free press

item.title: US sets Sept 23 shutdown for Iran airlines; Bessent warns non-compliant entities will be ‘knocked out of dollar system’
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that Iranian airlines will be globally shut down by September 23. Countries allowing Iranian aircraft to land may face secondary sanctions, including exclusion from the dollar system.

item.title: Gujarat Police warns against Garba partner for rent: ‘Forehead kiss for ₹2,000, basic dance steps for ₹1,000’
item.description: Ahead of Navratri 2026, the Gujarat Police warned against 'rent a Garba partner' ads and posts online. Here's what the packages are offering.

item.title: Who is Suryakant Waghmore? IIT-Bombay professor questions faculty protest of dean's removal over student suicide
item.description: Suryakant Waghmore, IIT-Bombay sociology professor, has slammed the Faculty Forum for supporting Professor Doolla amid a student suicide case. He argues the forum is imposing pressure on the investigation and questions the appropriateness of their protest following Doolla's removal from deanship.

item.title: NHAI sets uniform design norms for high-speed access-controlled highways
item.description: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has introduced a uniform design framework for high-speed access-controlled national highways, seeking to standardize how such corridors are planned and designed as India expands its network of high-speed roads.

item.title: 5 life lessons from NSA Ajit Doval’s speech at IIT Roorkee: Common trait of successful people, ‘know your map’ and more
item.description: NSA Ajit Doval spoke about the balance between audacity and responsibility while addressing IIT Roorkee graduates. He shared insights on understanding oneself, making informed decisions and remaining true to values.

item.title: Hyderabad woman says 'Padh lo' as she shows Salesforce's 5-star US stay: What benefits are offered?
item.description: Anushka S, a Design Lead at Salesforce, shared a sneak peek into the 5-star property where she had been staying in Seattle, United States, during a week-long company offsite.

item.title: Presley Gerber dies at 27: A look at Cindy Crawford’s son’s career, DUI arrest and ‘misunderstood’ tattoo
item.description: Presley Gerber, the only son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, has died aged 27 at a rehabilitation facility. The model had spoken publicly about mental health, addiction and recovery in recent years.

item.title: Flying abroad? DigiYatra trials for international departures may soon begin at Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru airports
item.description: DigiYatra is to roll out its facial recognition-based system, saving time for international flyers from India, as per the latest update. The initial testing phase is said to begin at Delhi and Mumbai.

item.title: White House TV press pool stops Trump coverage after ban; CNN, MS NOW and Politico to file lawsuit
item.description: CNN, MSNOW, and Politico are suing the US government for banning them from the White House, claiming a First Amendment violation. They argue this action deprives the press of rights without due process, challenging government interference in reporting.

item.title: US tightens visa rules from October 1: What Indian media professionals need to know
item.description: US visa screening rules will expand from October 1, requiring India-based media professionals applying for I, TN and TD visas to keep social media profiles public or open. The measure also applies to dependents and expands existing online screening.

item.title: Why ministries and regulators are turning to the CCPA on consumer grievances
item.description: The top consumer protection watchdog is increasingly finding itself at the centre of grievances spanning sectors it does not directly regulate, as government ministries, departments and sectoral regulators seek its help in resolving complaints that fall between regulatory jurisdictions.
